title: No single e2e proof that a media project runs start-to-finish across router+adapter+store+QA

rcca.root_cause: Media pieces were unit-tested in isolation; integration gaps across the chain had no acceptance test.
rcca.corrective: Hermetic per-modality e2e (detect->pack->generator->asset->context->QA) + async lifecycle + billing_unit + text-only regression guard.
rcca.preventive: The chain is exercised offline on every run; live smoke opt-in; regressions caught at the integration boundary.
